observations:
Third-reader verified inventory. All 4 original screenshots (1363-1366 px wide, 584-589 px high), the 8 pre-rendered zooms and additional tight crops (prefix c in the zoom folder) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option list, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (4 reports, 30 sections, 48 controls); their differences were note wording only. Every point was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: the selected list radio of every file, blue-mark detection for every selected criteria radio and ticked checkbox, the fill colour of every button and input box, glyph dumps of every field value and of the disputed header letters, and a per-row scan of every pixel that differs from its row background in the criteria panel, the left panel, the title bar and the panel edges. Nothing exists beyond the controls listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no extra column of controls, no greyed-out control, no dropdown, no instruction / warning / legend text, no scrollbar on either panel and no footer text (below the panels 1.PNG, 3.PNG and 4.PNG show only a text-free light-grey frame strip a few pixels high; 2.PNG ends at the panels).

COVERAGE: 4 screenshots = 4 reports, each selected exactly once, in list order: 1.PNG = Procedural Recall Report, 2.PNG = Scheduled Recall Report, 3.PNG = Recall Due Report, 4.PNG = Post-Op Report. All four are the same two-panel screen in its default state - no popup, no expanded picker, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen. Consequently the contents of every SELECT dialog (offices, office groups, patient types, providers, hygienists, recall procedure codes) are NOT documented by these screenshots.

SCREEN CHROME (identical in all 4): dark title bar with 'Recall Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon at the far right (the icon has no text, so it is not listed under actions). Left panel header 'SELECT REPORT' with exactly four radio entries in a 2 x 2 grid (left column: Procedural Recall Report, Scheduled Recall Report; right column: Recall Due Report, Post-Op Report); the rest of the left panel is a uniform empty dark area, so the list is neither clipped nor scrollable. A small splitter / collapse handle (three dots) sits on the border between the two panels. Right panel header 'REPORT CRITERIA' carries the CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end; it is grey in all four screenshots while every other button is blue, which appears to be its normal styling rather than a disabled state (not provable from the pixels). A fixed action bar at the bottom right of the criteria panel holds the blue buttons PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon); the left part of that bar is empty.

RECURRING PATTERN: PRINT FORMAT (PDF / Excel, default PDF) and OFFICE/GROUP (Office / Office Group radios, default Office, plus an unlabelled picker showing 108 = the OID of the title bar) are identical in all four reports. Every report has one date-range section with Start Date and End Date (both 11/21/2026 = the capture day, i.e. the default appears to be today), an EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE picker (default None) and an Include Inactive Patients checkbox (unchecked). DIFFERENCES: the date section is PROCEDURE DATE RANGE in Procedural Recall and Post-Op, SCHEDULED DATE RANGE in Scheduled Recall, and RECALL DATE RANGE with an extra radio pair Recall Date Range / No Recall Date in Recall Due. The provider filter is TRANSACTION PROVIDER in the two procedure-date reports and PREFERRED PROVIDER plus PREFERRED HYGIENIST in Scheduled Recall and Recall Due (all default ALL). RECALL PROCEDURE CODES (default ALL) and the Age Range checkbox (checked) with From 0 / To 999 exist in the three recall reports but not in Post-Op. SCHEDULED/NOT SCHEDULED (ALL / Scheduled / Not Scheduled, default ALL) exists only in Recall Due. This category has no REPORT FORMAT, GROUP BY or SORT BY section.

CONVENTIONS: none of the pickers has a row label of its own - the section header is the only caption - so label is left empty, as for unlabelled radio groups. A picker is a read-only box (grey fill 220,223,226) plus a blue SELECT button; the date boxes and the From / To boxes use the lighter editable fill (241,241,241). SELECT icons: building for the office picker and for RECALL PROCEDURE CODES, person-plus for EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE, single person for the provider and hygienist pickers. Sections that sit side by side are listed row by row, left then right. All controls are enabled in every screenshot.

FONT CAVEAT: the bold uppercase header font draws G almost like C at this resolution, so the header pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', '... DATE RANCE' and 'PREFERRED HYCIENIST'. A glyph-level comparison shows the small G spur at the lower right of that letter, which the genuine C in OFFICE, PROCEDURE, RECALL and SCHEDULED lacks, and the regular-weight radio label 'Office Group' under the first of those headers shows a clear capital G with its crossbar, so the titles are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP, PROCEDURE / SCHEDULED / RECALL DATE RANGE and PREFERRED HYGIENIST.

TRUNCATION: only 3.PNG (Recall Due Report) is clipped - its last visible row, Include Inactive Patients, is cut by the bottom action bar after 13 of its 20 px and no scrollbar is drawn, so any control below that row would be invisible. The other three screenshots end with uniform blank panel above the action bar.

Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Procedural Recall Report); it applies to every report of this category that has the Office / Office Group radios.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: `Office` = one or more offices; `Office Group` = groups from setup.

supplement_unresolved.question: What happens to the From / To boxes when Age Range is unticked? Not documented (the same row exists on Scheduled Recall Report and Recall Due Report).

Is the RECALL PROCEDURE CODES list limited to recallable codes on Scheduled Recall Report and Recall Due Report? The document states only that any code can be chosen on Procedural Recall Report and that ALL means every recallable code on Recall Due Report.
What does No Recall Date select - presumably patients without any recall due date (unverified) - and what happens to Start Date / End Date when it is chosen?

The document says accounts flagged Send to Collection are excluded from ALL recall reports, but the vendor article it cites is about the procedural recall report. Confirm the exclusion on Scheduled Recall Report, Recall Due Report and Post-Op Report.

Picker dialogs this document does not describe (it refers to legacy_report_outputs_daily_my.md for the picker dialogs): Transaction Provider, Preferred Provider, Preferred Hygienist, and the layout of the Recall Procedure Codes and Exclude Patient Type dialogs - for the last two only the value domain is given.

The Office / Office Group semantics and the UPDATE MY FAVORITES relabel are stated by the document as cross-cutting facts for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens and are recorded once, on Procedural Recall Report. Confirm that they hold on every report screen of the category.

Rights: the vendor lists the security right Reports - Recall Reports Screen in two variants, Full Control and View Only (view only = see the report list and the parameters, cannot generate). How View Only shows on the criteria screen (PRINT / PREVIEW hidden or disabled?) is not described, so no rule is recorded.

Vendor sources the research could not read and that may document the criteria left open here (No Recall Date, the Age Range row): the release-note articles (sign-in required) and the video-only webinar 17 Recalls Keep'Em Coming Back For More.
